name: mundane
description: Everyday, real-world subjects for ordinary (non-fantasy) image libraries.
caption_instruction: You are naming an everyday photograph or illustration. Identify the single main subject and give it a short, plain, descriptive 2-4 word name (for example: red-sports-car, golden-retriever-puppy, mountain-lake-sunset). Be concrete and literal; do not invent fantasy names. Reply with only the name, lowercase, hyphen-separated, no punctuation or articles.
